harassment: Report abusive accounts on the platform.
Tell a trusted person if threats escalate.
blackmail: Do not pay without seeking support.
Escalate immediately if intimate images or physical harm are threatened.
hacking: Change passwords from a clean device.
Check account recovery email and phone settings.
impersonation: Save the profile URL and screenshots.
Report the fake profile to the platform.
Warn close contacts if the fake account is contacting them.
doxxing: Document exposed information and where it appeared.
other: Seek trusted support if harm escalates.
